stack.storage: Cloudflare D1, Cloudflare KV, Drizzle ORM
stack.ai: Model Context Protocol (MCP), Vercel AI SDK, OpenAI, Anthropic

verifiedFacts.problemSolved: AI context windows are ephemeral and isolated per conversation session. When users start a new chat, the model suffers from catastrophic context loss. Storing notes and bookmarks across disconnected tools causes severe knowledge fragmentation.
verifiedFacts.memorySystem: Operates as a high-speed context and memory layer scoped per namespace (/ns/{namespace}). It ingests chat logs, documents, web URLs and markdown, extracting structured facts, entity relationships, and updating persistent state.
verifiedFacts.differFromTraditionalRAG: Traditional RAG performs dumb chunking and raw vector similarity (cosine) matching on documents without understanding temporal changes or user persona. Supermemory separates 'memory' tasks (full graph & profile extraction) from 'superrag' tasks (scalable document chunking), preserving entity links and chronologically synthesized user context.
verifiedFacts.userProfiles: Maintains an always-on synthesized user profile (/profile endpoint) returned in ~50ms. Profiles dynamically split into stable long-term facts (preferences, background, skills) and recent short-term activity without bloating prompt token windows.
verifiedFacts.mcpIntegration: Supports the Model Context Protocol via 'supermemoryai/supermemory-mcp'. AI coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex can directly query persistent memory tools (recall_memory, save_memory) natively during development workflows.
verifiedFacts.connectors: Cloud platform offers managed background connectors for Google Drive, Notion, Gmail, OneDrive, and GitHub webhooks, plus a Chrome extension for browser bookmarks.
verifiedFacts.localDeployment: Fully self-hostable via binary (`curl -fsSL https://supermemory.ai/install | bash` or `npx supermemory local`) and official Docker Compose (`compose.yaml`). Supports local embeddings via Ollama and embedded local database.
verifiedFacts.developerUseCases: Persistent memory for autonomous AI agents, personal second-brain assistants, cross-IDE shared coding context between Cursor and Claude Code.

benchmarksClaimed: Evaluated on LongMemEval, LoCoMo, and ConvoMem benchmarks
